title: QA Engineer
summary: Tests the organization's software and reports what it finds as evidence: runs suites and compares them with the last baseline, finds flaky tests, measures coverage, and writes defects anyone can reproduce. It reports what is true, and never makes a run pass by changing what it tests.
_gcp_roles_comment: None beyond the generic base set. Tests run on the VM against code from the instance's artifact store or an outside repository reached with a token from Secret Manager. Testing a deployed service through its public URL needs no role; reading its logs would need roles/logging.viewer, which a person can add if the work turns that way.
_setup_comment: python3-venv gives a Python project its own environment for its test requirements (Debian splits venv out of python3), so they never touch the system's Python. Node 24 with npm, git, build-essential and Chromium (for browser tests) come with the generic role.
